items.message: Attacker-controlled content from pull request remarks reaches `Ticket.as_context` tagged UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL, but the tagging boundary depends entirely on `with_review` being the sole caller and on downstream consumers respecting provenance — the diff does not show enforcement at the consumer side.

The `gh pr list --limit 60` result is taken at face value; `headRefName` comes from the GitHub API and is matched by `is_run_branch_for`, but the raw PR metadata fields (title, url, body) flow into `ChangeRequest` without sanitisation before being formatted into prompt blocks.
The `_clean` regex strips only one specific HTML-comment pattern; other HTML comments or embedded markup in reviewer bodies pass through to the prompt unmodified.

A `RuntimeError` from the pulls comments endpoint is silently swallowed and `notes` is set to `None`, causing line-note collection to be skipped without any indication in the returned `Remark` tuple or the caller's `note` string.
